extDescription.message: Reader mode that stitches the following pages together as you read, keeps images, video and audio, and translates with a local LLM.

closePromptHint.message: Leave temporarily to keep the article and completed translations in this tab. Leave permanently to discard them.

prefetchHint.message: Set to 0 to load the next page only when you near the end.

fontHint.message: Literata and Inter are bundled with the extension and include full Vietnamese diacritics.

ruleNone.message: If the next page is detected wrongly, pick the "Next" button on the original page.

noContent.message: Couldn't find the main content on this page.

renderingPage.message: Page {1} needs JavaScript, opening it in a background tab…

extractFailed.message: Couldn't extract the content of page {1}

openNextTab.message: Open next page in a new tab

limitReached.message: Showing {1} pages, the limit you set.

duplicate.message: The next page repeats content already shown, so loading stopped here.

pickNextOnPage.message: Pick the "Next" button on the original page

pickerTip.message: Click the "Next" button or link. Press Esc to cancel.

pickerNotLink.message: That isn't a link. Click the "Next" button.

trContext.message: Context used to translate this page

optUnitPage.message: Whole page at once (keeps full meaning)

optChunkHint.message: Longer pages are split into consecutive parts, and each part receives the end of the previous one. The server context must hold the text, the summary and the translation: for 4000 characters use 8K–16K tokens (llama-server: -c; with -np N each slot only gets c/N).

optUseSummary.message: Add a summary of the previous pages to the context

optSummaryHint.message: Leave empty to use the translation model. Translation-only models (Hy-MT, TranslateGemma) summarize poorly, so choose a chat model such as Qwen or Gemma. With llama-server this needs router mode (several models).

optProfileHint.message: Hy-MT and TranslateGemma get a single user message without a system prompt, and Hy-MT gets its recommended sampling settings.

zapTip.message: Click anything that isn't part of the article to hide it, here and on later pages of this site. ↑ selects the surrounding block. Esc to finish.

ruleHidden.message: {1} items are hidden on this site.

ttsDblHint.message: Double-click a paragraph to read from there.

optTtsSourceHint.message: Auto reads the translation while translation is on (waiting for each paragraph if needed), otherwise the original.

optTtsAutoScroll.message: Scroll along with the paragraph being read

optTtsVoicesHint.message: These are the voices your browser and operating system provide. "Auto" prefers natural/online voices. If a language is missing, add its speech pack in the operating system's language settings, then restart the browser.

optTtsNoVoices.message: The browser does not report any voices.

optTrAuto.message: Start translating automatically when reader mode opens

optSelHint.message: On any page, select text, right-click and choose "Translate selection".

vidFramePip.message: Picture-in-picture: use the ⧉ button in the video's top-right corner.

errPortLost.message: Lost connection to the extension, try again

mediaVideoOnly.message: This video only plays on the original page

mediaAudioOnly.message: This audio only plays on the original page

whySeries.message: next entry in the series list

errTabTimeout.message: Timed out waiting for the page to load

errOllama403.message: Ollama refused the request (403). Set the environment variable OLLAMA_ORIGINS=chrome-extension://* and restart Ollama.

errNotHtml.message: The link isn't an HTML page ({1})

optLeadHtml.message: Click the extension icon or press <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>R</kbd> on a page to open reader mode. Changes are saved instantly.

optPrefetchHint.message: With 1: while you read page 1, page 2 loads; when you reach page 2, page 3 is found and loaded. With 0, pages load only when you scroll near the end.

optJsRender.message: If a fetched page is nearly empty, open it briefly in a background tab so its JavaScript can run

optKeepMedia.message: Keep video, audio and embeds (YouTube, Vimeo, SoundCloud…)

optEndpointOllamaHtml.message: Default http://localhost:11434. If you get a 403 error, set OLLAMA_ORIGINS=chrome-extension://* and restart Ollama.

optEndpointOpenAIHtml.message: Base address including /v1. LM Studio: http://localhost:1234/v1, llama.cpp server: http://localhost:8080/v1.

optNoThink.message: Turn off the model's thinking mode (Ollama; faster with Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1…)

optNoModels.message: The server is running but has no models yet.

optRulesHint.message: Created automatically when you use "Pick the Next button" in reader mode. Add a content-area selector if a page is extracted incorrectly.
